scenario: DS-source twin of the K vector formal/k/rgate.cool_refire: a cooldown rule fires again on an activation that arrives once the window has elapsed. The second activation is a meaningful change to the mutable slot n under the same key (a retract+assert, LFAC.2.5.3), so it is a fresh token and the activation key, composed of the key slot alone (LCDB.3.3.1), is the same (r, 1). Drives adapter_ds_rate_allow (rete/adapters.c) on the has_fired path: last_fire 0, now 10s, window 10s -- the boundary is inclusive, now >= last_fire + window fires. Pins the two fires and the inclusive boundary; does not pin what happens at 10s minus one tick (that is cool_suppress).
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    k: Int key
    n: Int mutable

rule r cooldown 10_s:
    Trig t
->
    log info "fire {t.k}"
